Figure 6:An input grid does not determine its task. Each row shows one input generated for training task A, with the output of task A’s rule and the output of task B’s rule on the same grid. Both are valid ARC tasks, and only the demonstrations or the id say which rule applies. Top: A (feca6190) draws diagonal lines from each colored cell on a larger black square, and B (7fe24cdd) lays out the input and its three rotations as four quadrants. Middle: A (91413438) tiles copies of the input, one per colored cell, and B (007bbfb7) places the input’s pattern in every tile whose cell is colored. Bottom: A (c3e719e8) places the whole input in every tile whose cell has the most frequent color. B (ac0a08a4) enlarges every cell into a block. The pairs are selected automatically: an input generated for A on which B’s verifier runs and returns a different valid grid.
